title: Directional first order approach for a class of bilevel programs
summary: In this paper, we study a class of bilevel optimization program, where the feasible set of the lower level program is independent of the upper level variable. For bilevel programs it is known that the first order reformulation of a bilevel program requires the convexity of the lower level program while reformulations involving the value function result in difficult optimization problems.
